cast.name: Republican Party
cast.evidence: The on-screen text says 'Republicans want to tax working Americans.'

cast.name: The Democrats
cast.evidence: The on-screen text is a tweet from the account '@TheDemocrats'.

central_claim: President Biden's tax policy favors working people by taxing the rich, whereas the Republican policy harms working people.
intended_effect: To persuade viewers that the Democratic Party sides with working Americans against the wealthy, while the Republican Party does the opposite.
